I got my government fertilizer coupon this year, so I will put two bags of NPK and one bag of urea on this maize field, just like my neighbor did last year. I will also spread manure because this is my own land and my father taught me to feed the soil. I will plant the hybrid seed that came with the program, not my saved local seed, because last season my local seed gave me small cobs. My wife and children will do all the work — planting, two weedings, and harvest — we do not have money to hire anyone, and I do not spray chemicals on food crops.
